Full skill text at 5★
Restores HP by 6% of the owner's Max HP for a single ally. If the target's HP is below 60%, increases the restored HP to 10% of the owner's Max HP. If the target's HP is below 30%, additionally restores HP by 6% of the owner's Max HP once.
Full skill text at 7★
Restores HP by 6% of the owner's Max HP for a single ally. If the target's HP is below 60%, increases the restored HP to 10% of the owner's Max HP. If the target's HP is below 30%, additionally restores HP by 6% of the owner's Max HP once. Cooldown -1 Additionally grants a [Shield] by 10% of the owner's Max HP for 2 turns when this skill restores allies' HP each time.
